description.text:
White Flare (白焰迸涌) is a Scarlet & Violet booster in Simplified Chinese, released on 6 November 2026 together with Black Bolt (黑雷奔流). Between them the two packs hold all 156 Pokémon first found in the Unova region, and every Pokémon in them also has an Art Rare or Special Art Rare card. Reshiram ex is on its pack, with Whimsicott ex, Keldeo ex, Jellicent ex, Bouffalant ex and Hydreigon ex and the Supporters Hilda, Cheren and Harlequin. It is Japanese White Flare in Chinese, card for card at the same numbers, except its Special Art Rare 173/086, a new painting of Hilda. The cards are numbered to 086, followed by Art Rare cards of its Pokémon, Super Rare Pokémon ex and Supporters, Special Art Rare cards, and Reshiram ex as a Black White Rare, drawn in white, at 174.

A White Flare coin set came out the same day, with three 5-card packs, one of 78 chosen holos and a matching coin; its Common, Uncommon and Rare holos come in a Poké Ball pattern or, one in a hundred, a Master Ball pattern.
